create_volume_mount: create a Volume dataclass to mount a model, dataset, bucket, or space into a container
build_space_runtime_info: build a SpaceRuntime object from API response dict containing stage, hardware, sleep time, and volumes
search_spaces_results: search Hugging Face Spaces and return SpaceSearchResult objects with runtime, AI descriptions, and scores
manage_space_secrets: manage SpaceSecret dataclass for write-only secrets with key, description, and update timestamp
configure_space_variables: configure SpaceVariable dataclass for environment variables with key, value, description, and update time
